versions.changelog:
## wdh 0.3.1

- Documentation updated in SKILL.md.
- No code or CLI changes; version bump only.

- Version bump to 0.3.0.
- Removed the file "skill-card.md".
- Documentation updates in SKILL.md with no new features or breaking changes indicated.

- Adds support for all seven WDH.sh pay-per-call utilities through a single CLI and USDC/x402 payment flow on Base mainnet.
- No signup, no API key, and gas handled by the backend; only need to provide a USDC-funded EVM wallet private key.
- Covers big file uploads, URL shortening, Chart.js chart image rendering, hosted markdown publishing, QR code generation, paid feature requests, and paid support tickets.
- Documents service pricing ($0.001–$5.00 USDC per call), supported flags, environment variable requirements, and example usage for each tool.
- Recommends usage scenarios and provides installation and usage details for agents and users.
